title: Ender's Bench site
description: Set what visitors may run. Keys are stored encrypted and never reach the browser. Start this Actor with a long timeout: its container URL is the site's address for as long as the run lasts.

models.title: Models on offer
models.description: The Run button offers only these. Each entry: id, label, provider (script, anthropic, openai, openrouter, bitdeer, featherless or custom), model, and for custom an optional baseUrl and effort. Optional lobby: the setup page's model this entry is (e.g. Ender), and for custom, database: the provider:model the database asks in a Clearing run (e.g. ender:ender). Every run spends your keys, so keep the list short.

caseSets.title: Case sets on offer
caseSets.description: Any of quick (7 cases), held-out (25) and all (70).

maxRunsPerHour.title: Runs per hour
maxRunsPerHour.description: The site starts one run at a time and at most this many per hour.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic API key
anthropicApiKey.description: Needed for any anthropic model in the list.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Needed for any openai model in the list.

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: Needed for any openrouter model in the list.

bitdeerApiKey.title: Bitdeer API key
bitdeerApiKey.description: Needed for any bitdeer model in the list (Bitdeer AI Model Studio).

featherlessApiKey.title: Featherless API key
featherlessApiKey.description: Needed for any featherless model in the list.

customBaseUrl.title: Custom endpoint base URL
customBaseUrl.description: The OpenAI-compatible API for custom models without their own baseUrl, for example our fine-tune on RunPod. Kept secret so the endpoint isn't published.

customApiKey.title: Custom endpoint API key
customApiKey.description: Sent to the custom endpoint, if it needs one.

crsLive.title: Use the live CRS sandbox
crsLive.description: Runs started here send each CRS check to the sandbox with the login below. Off: the saved Oct 24 responses.

crsUsername.title: CRS sandbox username
crsUsername.description: Only for live CRS. Passed to each run as encrypted input.

spacetimeToken.title: SpacetimeDB login token
spacetimeToken.description: A login that may run the shared world (its owner's: `spacetime login show --token`). With it, the setup page's Start a benchmark runs the Clearing on Maincloud, where the database asks the models itself. npm run actors:site fills it in.

spacetimeHost.title: SpacetimeDB server
spacetimeHost.description: The HTTP address of the server the shared world is on.

spacetimeDb.title: SpacetimeDB database
spacetimeDb.description: The shared world's database name. The viewer watches the one it was built for (actors/build.mjs).

clearingRunsPerHour.title: Clearing runs per hour
clearingRunsPerHour.description: One Clearing run at a time, and at most this many an hour. Each one asks every survivor's model many times.

clearingMaxMinutes.title: Longest Clearing run (minutes)
clearingMaxMinutes.description: The site pauses the world after this long even if the rescue hasn't resolved.

benchActor.title: Benchmark Actor
benchActor.description: Which Actor the Run button starts, as username/actor-name. Empty means your own enders-bench.

benchMemoryMbytes.title: Memory per benchmark run (MB)
benchMemoryMbytes.description: Memory for each run the site starts.

benchTimeoutSecs.title: Timeout per benchmark run (seconds)
benchTimeoutSecs.description: A run that takes longer is stopped.
